subject: Request: Phased-delivery invoicing waiver & temporary Net-90 for Tessera Health
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Thompson <alicia.thompson@tesserahealth.com>, Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@tesserahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Phased delivery / invoicing cadence for pilot - ask

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick follow-up on the procurement constraints you described: Tessera's finance team is asking that we invoice on a quarterly cadence and that invoices be paid Net-90 for the first six months of the pilot so the invoices align to your internal funding release schedule.

We want to help make the pilot frictionless. The proposed ask: Redwood will accept quarterly invoicing + Net-90 for the first two quarters (a six-month pilot), on the condition that we:
- Have an executed SOW that references the existing MSA
- Receive a PO that references the MSA prior to the first invoice
- Complete a quick credit check and keep outstanding exposure capped at $250k

I’m looping in Vanessa (sales ops) to track the PO and Marissa (AM) for delivery. If that works, I’ll escalate internally for temporary approval and share the required redlines. I’ve attached a draft SOW and the mutual action plan.

Next steps: please confirm you can deliver a PO that references the MSA and whether procurement needs any additional paperwork. If you confirm by end of Wednesday (5/12), we’ll prioritize the internal review.

Thanks —
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alicia Thompson <alicia.thompson@tesserahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@tesserahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Phased delivery / invoicing cadence for pilot - ask

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick recap. Yes, procurement is asking for quarterly invoices and Net-90 for the upcoming pilot because our grant funding is disbursed on a calendar quarter basis.

We can provide a PO that references Redwood's MSA but will need the SOW finalized before procurement signs the PO. Ben is our procurement lead and will own the PO. I’ve copied him.

Two questions before you escalate:
1) Are you able to put a hard cap on outstanding invoices during the Net-90 window? Our procurement team typically requires a limit.
2) Will Redwood accept milestone-based invoices tied to delivery phases if that simplifies our internal approvals?

If you can confirm those points, I’ll push procurement for an expedited PO.

Best,
Alicia

Alicia Thompson
Director, Strategic Programs | Tessera Health
alicia.thompson@tesserahealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Tessera request — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 (temporary)

Team —

Tessera (prospect -> pilot worth ~$420k ARR first year, $1.9M TCV if scaled) has asked for a temporary billing exception: quarterly invoices and Net-90 payment terms for the initial six-month pilot. Context: grant-funded disbursement schedule — they cannot pay monthly and procurement will only sign a PO that maps to quarterly invoices.

Risk / impact:
- Credit exposure if invoices are unpaid for up to 90 days; projected exposure for the pilot is roughly $210k at quarter close.
- Process complexity: requires PO referencing MSA before first invoice; legal review for redlines.

Proposed mitigation (we recommend conditional approval):
1) Temporary 6-month waiver for monthly invoicing -> quarterly invoicing, with Net-90 for first two quarters only.
2) Outstanding exposure capped at $250k; no discounts beyond current negotiated rate.
3) Require signed SOW + PO referencing MSA prior to first billing. If the PO is not received within 21 days of the signed SOW, Redwood can revert to standard monthly billing.
4) Finance to run credit check and place account on AR monitoring; require monthly usage reporting from Tessera.
5) Legal to include a termination-for-nonpayment clause and an earnback for credits if payment timelines slip past agreed thresholds.

Requested approvals:
- Laura: legal redline guidance and required contract language
- Rishi: finance approval for temporary Net-90 and exposure cap
- Marissa / Vanessa: confirm commercial impact and that no additional discounting will be offered to compensate for extended terms

Can we get signoff by COB 5/10? Tessera is tracking this closely and needs to know if we can take the PO path.

Thanks —
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Tessera request — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 (temporary)

Jonas / team —

I reviewed the SOW and the commercial ask. Legal will accept a temporary invoice cadence change under the following contract-level conditions:
- The SOW must reference the standing MSA; the MSA must remain the master agreement.
- Add specific language: "Invoices issued quarterly during the six-month pilot are payable Net-90 from invoice date. Outstanding exposure shall not exceed $250,000 without prior written approval from Redwood's finance team."
- Include a dedicated termination-for-nonpayment clause that permits suspension of services 7 days after a 30-day breach beyond Net-90 (to allow a short cure window).
- Require Tessera to provide a PO number that will be referenced on each invoice; if no PO is provided within 21 days of SOW signature Redwood may invoice on its standard monthly cadence.

I attached the redline (MSA_redline_Tessera_20270510.docx) with the exact clause text and a recommended PO and audit clause. Also recommend we do not offer any price concessions tied to payment terms.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T14:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Tessera request — Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 (temporary)

Team —

Finance will approve a limited temporary Net-90 and quarterly invoicing for the six-month pilot under these conditions:
1) A completed credit check with acceptable risk score (I’ll run this tomorrow).
2) Outstanding exposure capped at $250k — if they exceed this cap, invoices will revert to 30-day terms until the balance is reduced.
3) Signed SOW + PO referencing MSA before the first invoice is issued.
4) Redwood retains the right to assess a late-processing fee (1.5% monthly) for invoices unpaid beyond Net-90; this should be disclosed on the invoice.
5) We do not increase discounts or modify pricing to offset payment terms.

If those guardrails are acceptable, I approve the temporary cadence. I’ll confirm the credit check result by EOD 5/11.

-Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Thompson <alicia.thompson@tesserahealth.com>, Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@tesserahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Final: temporary approval for quarterly invoicing + Net-90 (Tessera pilot)

Alicia / Ben —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed. We can accommodate Tessera's request for quarterly invoices and Net-90 for the initial six-month pilot with the following agreed conditions (summary):

1) Documents: Signed SOW that references Redwood's MSA and a PO from Tessera that references the same MSA must be received prior to first invoice.
2) Credit & exposure: Redwood will complete a credit check. Outstanding exposure is capped at $250,000. If they hit the cap, Redwood can revert to 30-day terms until balance is reduced.
3) Contract language: Legal will add temporary invoice cadence language and a termination-for-nonpayment clause (see attached redline).
4) Fees: Redwood reserves the right to apply a late-processing fee of 1.5% monthly for invoices unpaid beyond Net-90.
5) Term: This exception is limited to the first two quarters post-SOW signature (six months). After that, billing reverts to standard monthly cadence unless both parties agree in writing to an extension.

Attachments: Tessera_MAAP_SOW_v3.pdf; MutualActionPlan.xlsx; MSA_redline_Tessera_20270510.docx (see DocuSign link below for SOW execution).

Next actions for Tessera: please confirm you can issue a PO that references Redwood's MSA and provide a target date for signature. If you confirm by COB 5/13 we will issue the SOW for signature and proceed.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/req/abcd-2027-tessera-sign
HubSpot: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/RDW-2027-1083

Looking forward to getting this pilot started.

Best,
Jonas
